gt_provenance.details: M5: emotion labels from human-authored prefixes.json (not model output). M6: GSM8K gold from dataset load_gsm8k() (real_gt). No model output used as GT.

score_normalization.details: M5: sklearn clf.score = proportion_correct / n_test_items. M6: accuracy = n_correct / n_valid. Neither uses model-derived denominator.

result_existence.details: M5: reports/M5_location.json and reports/M5_directions.pt exist; probe acc=1.00 at layers 4-36, null=0.28. M6: 9/13 planned runs exist in runs/M6/. MISSING: M6_patch_filler_L4, M6_patch_filler_L8, M6_steer_medqa_L8_ap1, M6_steer_L20_null_ap1 (4 descoped specificity/null controls). Only happiness_2_human tested (1/12 planned emotional prefixes). Significant scope gaps but no phantom results — all tracker rows accurately reflect run status.

dead_code.details: probe_location.py and mechanism_causal.py have no dead metric functions. All defined functions called in main(). mechanism_causal_batch.py is an alternate dispatch wrapper, not dead code.

scope.details: M5: 200 items × 24 conditions × 10 layers, 3 seeds — adequate. M6: 50 items (vs 200 planned), 1 emotion (vs 12), 0/3 specificity controls, 1 dose-response missing point (α=+0.25). CM causal sub-claim significantly under-powered. Scope gaps explicitly documented in tracker and EXPERIMENT_RESULTS. No overclaim in language — EXPERIMENT_RESULTS marks CM as 'partially-supported' with explicit caveats.

checks.eval_type: M5: intrinsic probe evaluation (human-authored emotion labels); M6: real_gt (GSM8K dataset)
